claim: Comparative Cross-Jurisdictional Analysis The collapse of the Federal Trade Commission's national rulemaking experiment in early 2026 created a massive regulatory vacuum, forcing the structural evolution of non-compete enforcement permanently back into the hands of state legislatures and local judiciaries
excerpt:
The Federal Trade Commission (“FTC” or “Commission”) is taking final action in light of Federal court decisions vacating the Commission's final rules in three of the Commission's recent rulemaking proceedings. These decisions vacated final rules revising the Negative Option Rule and promulgating the CARS Rule and the Non-Compete Rule. Each will be discussed in turn.
